description.value: Large riverside campground on the Quinsam River within Elk Falls Park, 3 km north of Campbell River off Hwy 28, offering paved easy access and a full-service base for year-round salmon fishing, old-growth forest trails, and a short side trip to the 25-metre Elk Falls waterfall.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active BC Parks campground (Elk Falls Park) with 122 sites per OSM, located 2-3 km from downtown Campbell River on Vancouver Island. The website prominently features a 'Book camping' button and references 'Frontcountry camping' reservation policies, confirming reservations are accepted. OSM tags indicate no internet access and no power supply, and a sanitary dump station is present. The website mentions proximity to downtown Campbell River (2 km), which supports food availability nearby. No mention of hiker/biker sites, showers, potable water, laundry, or other specific amenities in the fetched content.
concerns: OSM alt_name is 'Elk Falls Provincial Park Campground'; the BC Parks website refers to the park as 'Elk Falls Park' — the campground within is called Quinsam Campground, consistent with OSM name
No street address available from OSM or website; only directional description (3 km north of Campbell River on Hwy 28)
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active BC Parks campground on a major Vancouver Island highway, close to downtown Campbell River, offering convenient and affordable camping well-suited for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: BC Parks campground (Elk Falls Park) with 122 sites, located 2-3 km from downtown Campbell River
